text:
I come to Tijuana Flats for the churros, and stay for the hot sauces and nachos!

The staff there is great. Always friendly and helpful. I ask a lot of questions and they never seem to be annoyed! 

I also am guaranteed at least two free meals a year! They give out free meals for teachers and also for moms on Mother's Day. 

They have a bar of hot sauces that range from sweet to burn your tongue hot! The sauces have funny and unique names as well!

My next trip I plan to get the chocolate chip flautas! I am the kind of person that eats desserts first. Their churros are out of this world good and come with chocolate sauce.

Visited this wonderful restaurant in the middle of this historic town.  This family owned establishment is special - beautiful floor to ceiling windows and terrific food and appetizers. We went there for the wine tasting, which was great, but we'll be sure to return for an Italian dinner!

First time trying The BAO & already can't wait to go back. We got two 3-bao combos & honestly everything was delicious. My personal faves were the hot chicken, spicy beef, and truffle waygu. Their fries are also perfectly crisp. MUST TRY SAUCES. Seriously, I'm a sucker for a good dipping sauce & all of them were delicious. The black garlic was one that I definitely need more of next time. 
Their COVID-19 pick up situation is also pretty incredible. I placed my order through YELP & they have you come to side door (wait outside) to give you your food. Food was hot, fresh & packaged nicely. Very reassuring to know they are following guidelines so closely.

Absolutely love the Railroad Street bar and Grill! The service is fantastic and we love To sit out on the deck with our dog to enjoy our meals! Food is yummy! The deviled eggs are a must And there are always unique specials

Five of us stopped here after a movie. We liked it. Here's a run down:

I had the portabella and artichoke pizza. Flavor was great. Pizza was somewhat oily and the center of the pizza was undercooked.

My SO had the salmon salad. She said it was a bit salty but a good salad.

Others had chicken salads, Mac & cheese with meatballs and they liked them. One salad had to be made 3 times - to Sause's credit they kept after it until it was correct.

I enjoyed dinner and drinks with a friend on a Thursday evening. Some restrictions with covid have been lifted so the restaurant had a decent crowd. We sat upstairs by the bar. Our server (unfortunately forget his name) was polite and attentive. I enjoyed a glass of Rosé and had the tomato onion bacon salad. Think upgrades wedge salad. The tomatoes were the star. They were thick and juicy. The portion was nice and filling. My friend and I both had an espresso martini for dessert. It was delicious. Highly recommend trying if you've never had one before. Looking forward to coming back!

I have to many good things to say about Northside Social, so I'll make it quick. First things first, this was my first time dining with them and I was thoroughly impressed! Their menu is packed with so many great options I cannot wait to go back! Like with most restaurants I eat at, I looked up the menu before I arrived and checked Yelp of course. I decided to order the fried chicken & I'm so glad I did! I never make it to dessert when I go out so I made sure to eat only a few bites of my meal to save plenty of room for that rich brownie sundae  !! Brownie, peanut butter mousse, topped with a toasted marshmallow?! YES PLEASE!!!! I took 2 boxes home with me lol. Planning on my return to Northside Social very soon!
First time going in last night, we had a great time. The food was delicious specially the dumplings. Yum!

I hate to see all the bad ratings this place has. We ordered milkshakes and a chicken tenders basket with fries and it was all excellent. Such a large portion my daughter and I shared the basket. I am not a huge fan of breaded fried food, so it has be pretty good for me to like it! As a new business I'm sure they had/have a lot of kinks to work out, but I would give it try, they seem to be getting there!

Walked into a cozy and very cultural restaurant. I really like that that was very authentic and tasty. We got a margarita start that's so good we already pitcher. The taco salad with shrimp was so tasty you could taste all of the flavor and it was plenty of meat and shrimp in it. The sampler was plenty of food flavorful and also very diverse. The shrimp enchilada have plenty of shrimp and the authentic enchilada sauce topped it off. The super taco had the moly moly sauce and that really pushed it over making a dish overall even more delicious. It felt like it was steal we got so much food for the price you couldn't beat it. It wasn't something just throwing together, it was delicious on down to the last grain of rice. If we have any friends or family that like tacos or any Mexican will definitely be taking them here.

This is a hidden Gem, this Diner is Amazing. I'm a first  time customer but will certainly not be my family's last. Extremely welcoming starting with the hostess whom checked us in and they even have a service which texts you a link to see how many people are in front of you! (How cool is that!) Tasha was our waitress and she was AMAZINGGGGG, excellent service from start to finish. Joe the owner came by to see how everything was and for me that is what put the cherry on top the fact he was there ensuring everything was right was the perfect touch you don't get that type of service anymore. I appreciate this place and recommend it! If you're looking for a place with fantastic food, friendly service and excellent service look no further. I will be returning and so happy I found this place.
Yum! Tastes fresh and homemade, love the Indian bowl.

Tonight I ordered delivery from Gran Caffe L' Aquila and got the Tagliatelle Alla Panna, Burrata Roast Pepper Camponata, and Ricotta Cheesecake. The Burrata Roast Pepper was refreshing and paired well with the fresh mozzarella and pesto sauce. The Ricotta Cheesecake had fresh vanilla beans in it, a unique chocolate crust, and was not overly sweet. Unfortunately, the Tagliatelle Alla Panna was too heavy and I was not able to eat it. The pasta sauce was composed of a cream base, but the sauce was very oily/greasy.

They had us waiting in line forever for no reason. The place was empty inside. Tables all open 
Drinks took forever to arrive. My friends came later and we had seats for them at the table but they refused to let them in and made them wait in line. Another 30 min for an a drink order to arrive. Terrible service... terrible operations management. Lots of potential though. 
Also lights are way too bright for 12am- vibe is not there
Two stars because the set up is pretty but that's it

This is during COVID-19 but it is no excuse for poor service. Waited 10 min on line to place order. No problem with the weight it is understandable. I placed my order 2 fish for five dollars. There was a sign there, I was told a promotion ended and I could not get that. Oh well I ordered two cheeseburgers. There were three cars in front of me.  I waited 25 minutes to get two cheeseburgers. This is what I got: A cold, burnt, dried up hockey puck with dried up cheese on top of it.  I had already driven away, I couldn't go back and the line would've been another half hour probably.  How could anybody serve something like this to a human being. My dog would have loved it though!

Great steak spot. I couldn't believe I had never tried this place. It is very similar to a lot of chain steak spots though. They have a complimentary bread, so that was great. It came to our table fresh out of the oven :). The ribs were expertly prepared and delicious. The kid's steak was good, she ate every bite. I had a huge burger. I would say that my burger did not blow me away, but it was still good. The prices were reasonable though. My server was excellent. She was patient, knowledgeable, and friendly. I will definitely come back.

This was a spectacular experience!
Loveeed every bit of my time at Eleven Eleven. The food, ambiance, server (Marcia) were totally out of this world.
They bring back the restaurant experience I so much crave.
Keep it up!
Will definitely be back.
Best whole fish Ive ever eaten. Can't wait to go back and try more food off the menu.

Sonic is one of my favorites!!!! The chili cheese dog and their corn dogs. Yesssss please and thank you!  Oh my as I'm writing this I'm wanting it.  Ok I'm getting off track thinking of the yummy foot long hot dog with chili all over it..... raw onions.... mmmmm mustard and cheeseeeeee.....

Ok lemme stop . Get back on track girl. 

The food here is always good. Staff is nice.  Sometimes they are out of things like unsweetened tea when I order it. I mean how so?  How can you be out of unsweet tea. It's basically brown water lol I don't feel complete without my unsweet tea.  That's my only complaint. Don't run outta the tea! Geesh. 

But overall this is a good location so when in the area stop and get my favorite chili cheese hot dog and bring me one lol.

Went to RAD Brewery tonight and loved the new sign and tap handles!! They were busy with a Doodle Dog Romp event, loved seeing all the dogs having fun on the patio.  I was amazed how well the bartender handled all the orders with great customer service.  I actually had a customer asks me what I thought about the new name and rebranding.  I said I love the mission of RAD brewery to help children in sports and to support a community.  I feel you should give every change a chance!

Well back again. Sofia and her husband were nowhere in sight. Instead the place was being run by a bunch of Hispanics. That certainly accounts why the avgolemono that came with my lunch was way subpar; yuck! It tasted like chicken soup with a squirt of lemon juice. No smooth, velvety consistency; less seasoning than what's acceptable.

Anyway: Queen Bee got a Greek salad. She absolutely loved it! Fresh produce and well dressed; crisp and not soggy. Certainly a decent sized portion. It came out fairly quick along with my avgolemono.

Meantime, just a moment later the girl brought out my gyro meat atop a heap of rice pilaf. A nice little cup of tzatziki alongside as well as several warmed pita wedges. Meat was nicely done with a good amount of caramelization around the edges. 

We don't go here for the service (wasn't bad) or the atmosphere (nonexistent). We do so for the food and the fact that Sofia and her husband are charming people who make good food. I certainly hope they're both around next time so I can give them back their 4 star rating.

if i could give them 0 stars i would. old women with orange hair was extremely rude. she set up are table and waited 15 minutes and she still wouldn't seat us so we left. all she did was give us dirty looks and didn't talk to us. horrible experience so we left. also we came after a volleyball tournament with tons of people so you would expect them to impress us but no

So, the nights bartender, Anastasia...Yaaaas, Gurl!!! She knows what she's talking about when she recommends her fav.  Not only was she quick to never let my cup empty but she was intuitive. So, props ya girl. Visitors take my advice when I say....as soon as you enter hit a hard left into the "BAR" and homegirl will hook ya up! 
Cleavers...."sha-la-la-la-la-keep dee gurl" *Mic drop*

One of the things I love about coming here is the staff always great me with high energy and I always feel taken care of there. Just on my most recent visit Paul and Alyssa were working the sandwich line and we always have great convo. Now jersey mikes has become a part of my Friday routine cause I know I'll leave satisfied. Thanks guys!
Really good pizza. Very impressed with the pizza I got from Anthony's, the crust is as good as they claim!

My server, Maria, was very nice. The hostess was also warm and friendly, though I didn't note her name (she had gorgeous silver hair). I feel weird going to a sit-down restaurant to dine alone, but a friendly staff always makes me feel more comfortable. I decided to go with breakfast and get the French toast. I didn't notice it came with eggs and choice of protein, and since I'm a vegetarian, I asked if I could get some mixed berries instead of meat. Maria was very kind and brought me a little side of mixed berry compote. Yum!

Freaking delicious Beignets and coffee! Don't make the tourist mistake and wait in line, I asked an employee and its seat yourself, so if you see a table have at it! Bring cash as it is cash only. Don't expect anything else here, its simple and delicious but very limited options. The beignets are hot and covered in powdered sugar, we split an order (3) between me and my bf and it was perfect. Def try the coffee with Chicory but heads up, no lactose free daily options here!

These guys do a nice job making unique sandwiches with a great attitude during these tough times.  They have made it very safe to order and take a sandwich to go or find a seat outside if you'd like.  Very tasty:)

I had a fabulous experience at Positano Coast this past weekend. Once again, my bestie found a spot for brunch that was well worth the time spent. Upon arrival, we were greeted by two friendly hostesses that led us to our table that was positioned outdoors along the side of the restaurant. I must say, the restaurant did a great job making sure the the  outside seating area was just as beautiful as the inside. 

Our party of three for bottomless brunch was well taken care of by our waiter. I believe we all had something different (shown in the pictures) and everything was presented beautifully. My omelette was light, fluffy and delicious. My crew spoke highly of their meals as well. I will definitely return again and would recommend Positano Coast to all my friends and family.

A generic storefront in a nondescript strip mall, I had very low expectations. The small dining room had obviously been updated recently - didn't match the outside at all.  Server was very attentive, food arrived in a timely fashion. Salads weren't anything special. Breadsticks were killer!  And all four of our entrees were excellent... lasagna, manicotti, baked ziti and ravioli.  Huge portions (none of us finished our meals - they were equally as good for lunch the next day), flavorful and well seasoned. A surprisingly good experience!

Wow!  Is all I can say about this quant, and delightful place.  The food and pastries... on my... the pastries are outstanding!  Raised in NY with a local bakery around the corner no matter where in NY one lives, and very used to fresh, home made baked goods; this by far absolutely exceeded my expectation!  A hidden gem!  Thank you Elizabeth!  Your love can be tasted in everything you bake!
Unreal experience. Our waiter, Ernesto, was one of the best I've ever experienced. Go to O-Ku, and ask for Ernesto. You won't be disappointed.

If I could give a negative starred review I would do so.  A group of us decided to try out Charbonos during Devour so a reservation was made for 6 p.m. on Tuesday 2/3/2021 and confirmed by Charbonos via text.  When we arrived we were told we DID NOT have a reservation by a clueless hostess -- even AFTER my friend who made the reservation showed her Charbono had indeed confirmed it (in black and white right on her phone)!!!  Instead of offering an apology and making any effort to make things right -- the hostess decided to "punish" us by shunting us off to the bar and forcing us to be seated at the tightest table I've ever seen in a restaurant.  With 6 of us seated there we felt like sardines crammed in a can with our boobs literally resting on the tabletop.  At this point my friend was done after being chastised for being "snippy" with the unhelpful, unapologetic hostess by her immediate supervisor who my friend also spoke with to try to remedy the situation!!  
          Thankfully there was another manager there, Brandon, who became involved thanks to our waitress' intervention.  After a lengthy discussion with him we were moved to a 6 top table...but at that point our evening had already been ruined by extremely poor customer service.  The interesting thing is that while in the main dining room I noticed that there was one 8 top table (which we had the confirmed reservation for) and the 6 top table we ended up sitting at...and the only other party that arrived was a group

Place is a rip off! Large pizzas the size of anyone else's small. Cheesesteaks have no meat. Deliver charge is higher than anyone less than a mile from home. Only thing this place has good are their rolls.

My rating is not so much based on the taste or quality of the food but more for the value or lack there of. I ordered the scallops as an entree. I assumed that for $24 it would come with a side but nope. We had ordered the corn bread skillet to share 3 ways which turned out to be a great idea because otherwise I would have left hungry and extremely disappointed. When my plate arrived there were 4 small scallops over a bed of greens with a couple bacon bits. 4 small scallops at $6 a pop. What a joke. I will definitely not return.

It doesn't look like much but you will be pleasantly surprised! My favorite place and been going there for years! We usually stop in 2x's while on vacation. Great service, great food, and great drinks! Pool table and darts. You can sit outside in the parking lot. Don't laugh it's busy! Very laid back! Cheers!
Great food and atmosphere. We love the patio! Stop by for brunch on the weekend, great breakfast burritos, bloody mary's, and mimosa buckets.

I love love love Mama Roux! Not only is her food amazing but she is an amazing person. She was formally with Papa Roux the restaurant which is now closed. Yo Mama Roux opened in the same location and a lot of people don't realize she's there and/or opened! We need to get the word out! Mama Roux has been there for me, praying for me and providing food for us at some very difficult and meaningful times in our lives. She's not just another "business owner". She cares, she works hard, she's a wonderful Mom! I feel blessed to say she's my fried! So like I said, spread the word and let's get her business busting at the seams!!

Amazing. Among the best restaurants in Philly without question. We've tried several of the apps and entrees and everything is prepared perfectly, and flavors are so balanced. Don't miss Talula's Garden!!!

I love chipotle but for some reason at this 
location the food is AWFUL. Didn't taste like usual. Maybe just not enough folks to feed so the food just sits there all day... :-( .

Phew!   We picked it for six of us...food and delivery...it was excellent!   
This was "not" our go to delivery pizza place but we wanted to change it up based on our last lack luster food order from our normal place.  I was a bit worried when I placed my call and order bc the gal came across to me as if she were in training.  I didn't expect our order to be timely nor correct.  So glad I was wrong.  All 6 meals were right on (extra onions, sauce on side, dressing on side, no cheese...yeah...one of these customers...I know).  I was told delivery would be an hour but it was only a half hour total from the time I placed my call.  My Greek salad with grilled chicken was sooo good.  Chicken was tender and a very generous portion.  Everyone else thought their choices were delicious, generous portion as well...and hot.  Even the left overs were good at lunch.  Looks like we have a "new" go to place...they won us over.

I was told about this place from a barista at Starbucks up the street and I was craving sushi one day and found this place to order takeout during the beginning of the covid pandemic. And I was not disappointed, hit ever spot of my craving.

Awful. No burnt ends; no chicken. It's 1pm on a Saturday, so I give a MARGINAL pass on that. Land on the recommended 12 hour brisket...just no. Tough. No smoke ring to speak of. Served with ice cold sauce and a squished Publix hamburger bun.  Do yourself a favor--pass on this place.

If you love high quality gourmet pizza this place won't let you down. Plus the service was excellent you could see how the server would anticipate our smiles when she delivered our food choices. Thank you so much the a great lunch

One of my favorite spots in Nashville. Love the space, the atmosphere, the food, and most of all the fact that you can get a beer as big as your head. Patio is fantastic when the weather is nice, and the inside is inviting and comfortable when it's not. I come here a few times a month and will continue to do so!

We came here for cocktails and dessert and were happily surprised with how personable the staff was and how great the food and drinks were. We sat at the bar and were served by Addison who knew so many details about every alcohol they had and whipped me up several cocktails off the menu. He was interacting with every guest even though the bar was packed! We had the creme brulee and peanut butter chocolate mousse, both were rich and delicious! This is a must stop place in printer alley.

Tasty thin cracker style crust pizza. 12" was plenty for me and my 3 year old. The cheese has almost a creamy texture /taste- different than other pizza cheese. Will definitely eat there when in town again!
Great wings!!! I ordered pick up so I didn't get to take in the atmosphere but the bar and the inside are huge. Looks like a fun place for Sunday football.

Food and drinks were great. The staff seemed like they were annoyed to serve people. This place is very pretty and in a great neighborhood; it's too bad that their staff was so indifferent to their customers.

At this point I have tried 3 Dot Dash because of the constant recommendations and colorful reviews, and unfortunately my experience has not been as positive as I had hoped for.  

The first time I eat here was honestly enough for me to never try them again. So in between meetings I ordered some food and had it sent to me via Uber eats.  I got the Southwestern Chick'N ( Add Cheez Wiz & Vegan Bacon) + No Animal Style fries.  

The sandwich just wasn't good at all in my opinion.  The fries were not great either. For me it wasn't just one thing that I could pinpoint as the issue.  The food was cold. The presentation was horrendous and the taste was lackluster. The fries were something I had hoped to enjoy and even they were horrible. I believe this was mainly due to the fact that they were just drowned in sauce. I had hope that this poor experience could be partially attributed to the fact that I ordered the food via Uber eats.  

The second time I ordered the Fat Mac and fries . This time the food order was much better but still significantly missed the mark for me. My main complaint is that the food was really cold.  Which for me speaks to the quality along with presentation still being an issue. It had really good flavor from what I could gather it just was not what I expected it to be. 


I'm willing to give them another try.

Came here with two friends for the bottomless mimosa brunch and would not recommend it come back here for that again. The hostess was accommodating and let us extend our bottomless an extra hour, but we sat upstairs, which was empty and our bartender was extremely slow to make the drinks and ask for refills. I will say, he let us use pineapple juice rather than OJ, which was a good start. 

The actual brunch menu was pretty small so I ended up just getting French toast. This was the most basic and flavorless French toast. It looked like something I would make at home. 

It's a shame that the service and food was mediocre, because the atmosphere was really neat. Upstairs is very spacious and open and has huge windows letting in a nice breeze. I would come back here for a drink at the upstairs bar and to lounge but most likely wouldn't eat here again.

This was our first time at Rez Grill and it was all that.. food was delicious and service was impeccable ( thank you TARA)  We have booked  our next dinner with her and look forward to enjoying some more excellent food!! Thanks!
Crab cake sandwich was so overcooked it was tasteless. Gumbo was delicious, though. Mediocre service. Slightly above average overall.
I'm the customer.  If I accidentally ordered a cup but wanted a bowl you damn well better make it happen. It's not that fucking hard. Don't worry, I would pay the upcharge. Ridiculous.
虽然店看起来旧旧的，但是东西都很好吃。不要点现烤的肉，其他的东西都好吃。推荐他们家的chief special石锅拌饭还有牛仔骨。小菜的种类非常丰富还能refill，疫情之前去的时候老板娘有时还会送一些很少见的泡菜。
We love this place for their authentic atmosphere and delicious food. Everything is good, but definitely check out their daily specials for great food too!

I would have visited them and possibly had a ton of family fun, resulting in a high rating, but we never made it that far because I could not even get them to answer the phone. I need to ask them if it was a place appropriate for my two-year-old daughter and nine-year-old daughter but no one bothered to answer the phone even though I called multiple times. This place will never get my money. Thanks Dave & Buster's.

Their coffee is disgusting. Point blank, simple. Just straight up nasty. I tried giving this place a chance, but I'm not a fan. They wouldn't even let me exchange the coffee. I paid $4.66 for nothing. They wouldn't fox it, they wouldn't let me get something else for the same price, nothing..I just wasted my money. I won't be back.
A bit pricey, but cute and a great atmosphere. They bring your check in a book, I love it!
By far my favorite Cuban sandwich shop IN THE WORLD! JC's place has been my go to ever since 2015 when I first moved here. The staff is awesome, the atmosphere is great, but the food is unbelievable.

I have heard and read so much about this restaurant so I had to try it. Got a large plain pizza to bring to my boyfriends house and we loved it. I have to say it's the best pizza I have had.  I wanted to buy another pizza the next day.  Looking forward to trying more on their menu soon.

As a person who travels and eat many different cuisines, this Ruth Chris doesn't stand up to any location that I ever visited. The quality of the service is not stellar. I am a bit frustrated that I came to try it here in NOLA.


Food: overcooked Brussels sprout, overcooked steak

Service: not too attentive, which is a bummer

Ambiance: the environment is truly festive

Overall, I was not happy my experience. 
--------
Updated review-I stopped in last night and decided to sit at the bar to have dinner. The seared Tuna was amazing. I ordered a medium cooked petite filet and it was still over cooked. Maybe next time, I will ask for medium rare in order to get a medium cooked steak. The bartenders were extremely nice and accommodating.

I have been coming to caffeine roasters since they first opened. The food has always been delicious, and fresh, served piping hot. I went about three weeks ago and ordered a cheese pizza, and was extremely disappointed that I paid eight dollars for a burnt cheese pizza that tasted like a Tony's, or a Totino's pizza. It was definitely not fresh. I went there again today and ordered a medium Matcha, and received what appear to be the smallest macho that I have ever gotten from here. The girl claimed that it was a medium, and I try to explain to her that whenever I order that in the past it comes in the larger glass. She then informed me that they are under new management. Unfortunately since the new takeover this place has gone down hence my one star review. The old caffeine roasters would have gotten a five star review all day long. I will also mention that the computer screen that I had to sign was extremely filthy Both covered with food and with fingerprints. I would think at a time like this they would be wiping down the screen between each customer, especially since they are not that busy. Sadly I will not be eating here anymore.

I also ordered the roasted vegetable medley sandwich and got it on a baguette. The sandwich used to be delicious and actually had roasted vegetables on it. Now it is a sad sandwich full of steamed zucchini raw spinach and avocado and cheese. There are absolutely no roasted vegetables, much less a medley. I am really mad that I just spent $14 on t

This is the best one around. The others don't compare to this one. The spicy teriyaki chicken is amazing so spicy but great flavor. This one also has a side salad with the best dressing I've ever had. Definitely my favorite Asian food in all of Boise and meridian

My family and me stopped here for dinner after a long day road trip and coastal sightseeing 
Everything we ordered was delicious 
from the fresh ceviche to the tasty enchiladas 
My daughter had their breaded milanesa torta which was excellent! My granddaughter doesn't eat meat and their quesadillas in handmade tortillas were good too.
I highly recommend the potato tacos,those were my favorite.
The owner was so friendly and helpful explaining the menu to us. Our waitress was so friendly and went way beyond in her customer service. She kept bringing us more chips and salsa which were 100% delicious.
It is small family owned and run business 
They sell many authentic Mexican food products.
We will definitely be back next time we are in Carpinteria,
California

Wow! Another hidden gem out in the county. Got to drive around the building to find it but well worth it. Some of the most authentic tacos I've had in awhile. I'm definitely adding this place to my normal rotation.

Heard about this place when I was all the way in Yosemite, so I had to check it out on my drive through. The Gnar burrito was delicious. We came in during the lunch rush and they were pumping out sandwiches like crazy! Don't let the facade deter you, it looks like an odd place for a deli, but it's a hidden gem.

Delicious food, ample portions, great prices, friendly service!

Since I'm type 1 diabetic & eat low carb, I ordered the low carb grilled chicken salad & it was perfect. The guys make it right in front of you so you can choose what you want. The chicken was excellent - moist & flavorful. Fantastic feta. Drizzled in ranch. Look at the picture. It's a masterpiece. 

My wife ordered the falafel plate. She liked the cucumber dipping sauce & said the falafel was unique - lighter/less dense than others we've had, but still filling.

We'll definitely be coming back!
Best noodle bar in Santa Barbara. Their drunken noodles is so good! The Monday special fried rice though is my favorite.

Went in after the comedy show of Trevor Noah at Tucson Music Hall. We went inside and ordered 2 tall can Miller Lites. 6 dollars for both and tipped $1. We went out and drank on the patio and then came in because of the smoke getting too much. I re went up to the bar to ask for a little tomato Juice to go with the rest of my drink. Gentleman in a jersey who I stood next to got upset because I offered to pay the bartender .55 - what I had in loose change for additional V8 to add to my Miller lite. Bartender had just given me tomato juice not asking for anything as I had already bought my drink, I have well over that amount but didn't feel like making another transaction on my card said evening. 
(Gentlemen in question got upset after watching me sprinkle Tabasco in my v8). I went back to table and a few moments later he accosted me at my table while I was with my friend and threw my change at me saying "who offers change to the bartender for v8" while throwing it at my table. Gentlemen in question is the OWNER of the bar. (Just found this out so updating) Bartender asked me to leave...... so she didn't have to deal with anything. I was not impressed, and felt assaulted by the drunk OWNER of the bar. Had I been beginning my night I would have gotten law enforcement involved. My friend was forced to leave out the side by the Bartender after telling her what happened. The OWNER of the bar then threw the change at her onto the street out the side door. I chugged my beer and left o

Let me tell you, the wings here are unmatched. I love the garlic parm flavor! The fries are also decent. The Philly cheesesteak egg rolls? Delicious! But I will likely stick to the wings and/or egg rolls - I've tried the mahi mahi tacos and didn't really enjoy them, they weren't as flavorful as I had hoped. I've also had a friend try a burger they didn't enjoy as much. If nothing else, you can't go wrong with their wings. I'll definitely be back for them.
Phenomenal crepes, great coffee and an even greater ambiance to work or hangout in. The staff has always been nothing but friendly and accommodating. Glad they are a staple in this neighborhood!
Tasty and hot food and cold beverages. This stop for frecreshments at WWII museum was great and the temperature of the food and drinks were perfect.
Excellent! Large portions and great flavor. Call in your order as it can take some time to get it ready. Will definitely be back!

This place is so wonderful!  Surf n turf my go to meal.  Big lobster with 2 perfectly prepared lamb chops.  Also includes rice and peas .  One potato slice.  My husband and sons have tried many other things and they never disappoint!  The backers is a big plus right next to restaurant. Have eaten here 20 times and always wonderful plus it is beautiful inside

I have never noticed this restaurant at all with living in edmonton. My co-workers decided to check it out after work on a tuesday for pasta night. The decor and feel inside is pretty outdated seeming but still nice inside. 

We all ended up starting with the caesar salad on special which was fantastic. I went with the diabloe pasta which could have been a bit spicier as it's described as spicy but it was still fantastic. 

We had a young boy serve us and all props to him. He didn't write a single thing down for 6 of us that included drinks, appetizers, and customized pasta.

Great vibe and atmosphere when we walked in.  Mr. Owner: hire some help man. It took over 10 minutes for a server to get to us just for a beer. That's not a statement about the server there just wasn't anyone available. The beer was great. We tried several.  The food was average at best. The brioche bun on our burger was 2x the size of the burger.  The ribeye on our cheesesteak was burned and hard. One of our 6 meals finally came out when the rest of us were halfway finished. The bathrooms were not in good shape and one of the two had no TP or paper towels.  Maybe this is a new place and still working out some kinks. I'd say great place for a beer and a snack but skip the dinner. Plenty of other options nearby.

This place is amazing. The service was great. The food came fast and let me tell you the coffee is amazing. I had the white mocha which was nice and smooth. Mixed to perfection. I had the lemon crepe which were light and the lemon was fresh. The place was clean and comfortable.

What a great experience all around. The staff was friendly and accommodating during this crazy time and the food was SPECTACULAR. One of the best dine in experiences we've had in a longggg time. The drinks were also amazing. Thank you for making our time there feel normal!

Honestly, the people who work their are great! Super helpful, & kind, but we aren't here to speak upon the employees, we are here to speak about the food, & the establishment. So let's get straight to the point. I honestly rate this place a 2 out of 5 stars. I'd probably rate it a solid 3 out of 5, if I went during the afternoon or early evening, sucks for me, I went at night, & that was a horrible idea on my part. It was poorly lit, I couldn't see my food very well at all, I hated the utensils, they sucked! The chicken was dry, like super dry, it was hard to cut into. The best part about my meal was the rice. I dined with my boyfriend, & we were so excited to try this "urban Latin food" experience together, & I was extremely disappointed. I had the pollo asado plate, & my boyfriend got the pollo asado sandwich. He described the sandwich as "un-juicy & quite cold". He had to masquerade the un-juicy lump of chicken with their "spicy mayo", & hot sauce.

Shapiro's never disappoints.  The bread and meat are high quality and the portion sizes are enormous.  Even though it is a bit pricey, it's well worth it.  My pastrami sandwich was delicious with tender meat.  I also had a cup of matzo ball soup which really hit the spot.  Another diner in my party got the meatloaf and said it was tender, well seasoned, and delicious.  It's always a treat to eat here.

High price with crappy food.  Screwed up two 30 dollar steaks.  The plate was ice cold, the rice and steak was too.  Rice would not even melt room temp butter.  Loved eating and finishing my steak while my sat there  eating on a redo.  Was hoping for a great steak for Mothers day.  Should have gone to Texas Roadhouse.

Nashville Jam Cafe  is a small venue located in an interesting-looking area close to 100 Oaks.  The day I visited here I arrived a few minutes before 2pm (closing time that day) but they greeted me warmly, seated me promptly and didn't rush me through my meal at all :-)

The menu contains a nice cross-section of sandwich and breakfast choices.  I ordered the blueberry compote (off-the-charts excellent!) and the bronut, which is a fried biscuit topped with cheesecake filling.  The latter was so good I almost licked the plate ;-)

To sum it up - the service is great, the food is excellent, and the prices are very reasonable.
One of my favorite restaurants in town. Great food and service will not disappoint me entertaining friends,
One word...Delicious. Ok maybe a few more words... service was great. Waitress remembered my order and the salad was delicious

This place was delicious! Great atmosphere for Valentine's Day and great pricing because it's byo. Had a great app and fantastic dinner. Staff is very friendly and we will definitely be back. Let's keep this place alive! Not too many good noodle places in town.

Still going by Frank's Pub to me.... forever. ;) 
However, regardless if we are calling it Franks or Tony Gs -  this local pub abd eatery is  the home of the Frosty Mug baby. Great bartenders, patrons and selections. The To Go window for a grab and go situation is convenient. This place will probably forever get love from me, for alit of reasons but check it out - go hungry. 
Ps-Get the loaded baked potato soup if your lucky enough to be there when it's on the menu- ask Keith, it's his best work ;) 
Cheers Big Ears ~

Very busy... which is not necessarily a bad thing. Just long wait. Staff seemed friendly. I had a Groupon and forgot to present it. They had to refund my order and redo the payment. Very nice of them for me being dumb! Cashier was not happy but did it non the less. After a 30+ min wait, the food was... nothing to swoon over. The Cuban was fine. The crab cake was very good!

Ordered two entrees for pick-up -- Prime Rib and Crab Cakes.  Both were large portions.  Prime Rib was very tender and crab cakes as always consistently good. Sides were broccoli and mashed potatoes.  Removed one star for the mashed potatoes that were bland and overly liquid. Still a good value.

I loved Green Lemon! Went on a Thursday night and the place was busy and full of energy. I ordered takeout and the workers were really helpful and sweet. Their shrimp tacos did not disappoint as well as their corn and nachos! I would definitely recommend this place for their food and customer service.

Outstanding!!!  What a gem...went on a Thursday night and it was packed.  6 of us went and everyone loved their meals.  Had Calamari, wings and flatbread to start. Fantastic.  Wood fired oven made the flatbread extra special.  Burgers, pasta fish and chips and the skewers were all excellent.  Will definitely be back...such a pleasant surprise!

The best "fast food" food you can get! Fresh burgers , everything made to order, and they have cheese curds!!! A huge plus and comfort food of the Midwest. If you like cod fish fry- they have a delicious one! Oh and yummy custard too!

"It will be 30 to 35 minutes for your order to be ready"  We show up 35 minutes later to be told the 3 XL pies "are just going into the oven - 15 to 20 minutes". 20 minutes later - " oh, only another 10 minutes _ the guy throwing the pizza crust didn't update the person taking orders".  1 hour and 30 minutes wait and lots of lies about our order.  The lost a  longtime customer tonight.
Absolutely LOVE this pizza. I'm kinda a sweet sauce girl, my husband is not...but this is a perfect mix for a happy home. I noticed this time the crust has a nice crunch.

This cookie shop has been a family favorite for years. I'm sure their breakfast and lunch is delicious but we normally go for the cookies. 

Purchasing cookies is a simple counter service transaction. The staff is always helpful, knowledgeable AND patience. 

One of our favorites is the "black and white" cookie. It was not available today. My child is allergic to all nuts (peanut and tree nut) and he is able to eat this cookie without problems (this is not an endorsement that YOUR child could do the same!) 

I've also ordered cookies from here for an event. The price was similar to other cookie shops. They were very professional with my order. Everything was perfect. The cookies were a big hit at the event! 

If you are in the area, Colleen's will not let you down! 

PS - excellent COVID prevention in place!
This is the best food ever! You have to try it to believe it! You will want to eat it again and again and again

My new favorite Mexican restaurant.  Yes the food is good, but the real treat is the service.  Chips & salsa almost immediately, water immediately, fast, courteous and welcoming!  Great outdoor space too!

First time here! I loved everything we ordered! We ordered- chicken egg rolls, beef skewers, roti, yaki udon and chicken dumplings. We shared this between 2 people and it was filling. Every thing we ordered was 10/10. Great first experience :)

I rarely give out five stars  but this place deserves it and so much more. I would have to say this is my favorite restaurant and the price tag is worth it! It's fine dining at its finest. The menu, dim lighting, simple architectural decor, open design where you can view the whole culinary team, the herb garden wall, fire place and exceptional service makes this place one of a kind. The restaurant is inside a home and it's easy to walk past it without giving it a second thought. I went during devour Indy and had a chance to try their pre-fixe menu without breaking the bank. They are known to change their menu frequently (I heard daily) therefore the devour Indy menu was not published. I did know what to expect going in since the menu was unknown. Its important to have an open mind when going into such a place since the chef is sharing an unique creation. The portion are small yet filling. This is not a place you would go to fill up..its almost like a tasting. But after multiple courses you won't leave hungry.

Nothing better than a great burger and awesome fries to go along with it!!   

Let's see if we can add some paper plates or something for the food. It gets annoying when you want to place your burger down but cant. You are wasting more napkins than you think. 

01/04/2020
Ok, have to upgrade my 3 stars to 5. This place has a fantastic combination of a burger and french fries. Good french fries are essential when eating a top notch burger. 

Without a doubt the best burger place around!
Wonderful place! Very wide array of food. Very gluten free friendly, with gluten free pancakes and waffles available! Cute interior and friendly staff.

This place was an amazing brunch spot! We brought our dog this weekend and the staff were super friendly and followed Covid safety procedures. It's in a really cute neighborhood in a quiet location. The food was really healthy in a good way, it was really fresh and delicious.
Best Mexican fast food restaurant in Tucson. Jason's has great meats and delicious flour tortillas. Don't forget to ask about the salsa options!

If you love tacos... 
THIS IS WHERE HAPPINESS RESIDES!

I visited Nashville for a safe graduation celebration this past weekend. This taco shop was not in our plans but the Moonshine Distillery that it is located in was. (I'll also be doing a review on the distillery)

Because this establishment is located WITHIN an establishment it's perfect for the vibes that surround it! Music, laughter, shopping, and most importantly alcohol. The young staff here were so kind and very quick with our orders. They were knowledgeable about the menu so any question we asked they were on top of it with a helpful polite reply. And if you've ever read my reviews you know kindness and respect is a big mark for me. They nailed it. Let's get into these tacos!

I was in a group of 6 women 5 of us ordered 3 tacos each and all 5 of us were more than satisfied with our decisions. Not only were the tacos unique but they had vegetarian options! This was major because within our group was a vegetarian so that really excited her! They replace any meat selection with jackfruit and it is seasoned and sauced as if it were the original version! How awesome is that? My friend definitely said it was an amazing group of tacos! I myself had the Lamb Gyro taco, the Bangkok Shrimp taco, and the Pork Belly taco. I have to say all three were mind blowing but the pork belly was definitely my favorite! It was the pickled watermelon rind for me! All the different flavors, the proper cooking of the meats, the fresh toppin

I am impressed, Loughmiller's Pub & Eatery was actually exceptional. The menu is great and I love the atmosphere. I was truly impressed with Skillet Burger, it was prepared perfectly. Terrific food. The staff are really attentive and nice. They're great at giving recommendations. Loughmiller's Pub & Eatery....Nothing but win.

Gourmet sandwiches, soups and salads. So yummy! I wish there were more gluten free soups and cookies, they used to have two. They have a delicious sourdough bread. Customer service is wonderful! I love the cozy fireplace in the winter! They don't freeze you out like so many other places. Great spot for a romantic dinner. Nice and quiet.

Terrible name, fantastic food! I was hesitant to come here because of the other thing "BJ" can refer to. However, the food was really good, much better than I expected for standard American fare, and it was presented nicely too. It's a spacious place that was busy but never felt overcrowded. Our waitress was super friendly and let us know we could get a free pizookie if we downloaded the app and signed up for their rewards club. Would definitely come back, but I wish they'd change the name of this place!

We have come here twice. Both times the food was... meh. The first time is was acceptable but didn't really stand out. A big bland, very saucy, over priced. 

The second time we thought we would try the signature dish, fried chicken. We received the soggiest, over sauced, and luke warm chicken. Our sides were also just bland. The fried okra was creamy but again, bland. 

I appears they are banking on how nice the place looks and the novelty of "southern cooking". Anyone from the south or who has ever had souther cooking would be disappointed. 

In the end we were served Luke warm soggy fried chicken and tastiest sides. 

Drinks were ok.
Best croissants& pasteries in NOLA . Almond and chocolate croissants were amazing !!!

Coffee - 5 stars - vanilla latte
Ambiance - 5 stars - beautiful pond, trees, and seating 
Breakfast - 4 - bacon was to die for
Dog friendly - 5 - was offered water to my dog 
Service - Patra was super friendly and prompt the couple times we visited.
This place is probably my favorite place to eat in town as a kid, can go here with friends, can go here with family, and staff is very nice, highly recommended

I was walking to get groceries one afternoon and stumbled upon Dottie's Donuts--it's tucked away along a row of brick homes, and is a cute, small store. I'm new to Philly and am trying to (safely) explore, and am sooo delighted to now have a favorite vegan donut store (and donut store in general)  honestly, I'd have no idea these were vegan! They were absolutely delicious and a perfect treat!

Ordering was contactless and fast, and the woman who helped recommend a few favorite varieties was so kind! Here's what I got (with thanks to her rec!) (Clearly, I love blueberries):

-blueberry and lemon: a beautiful bright lilac pink frosting, with lemon zest/sugar(?) sprinkled on top. the dough was so fluffy and a little cake-like, and the blueberry flavor was beautiful. tastes amaaaaazing microwaved!
-blueberry jam filled with maple glaze: oh my goodness I'd buy bottles of the jam! so light and floral almost, and perfectly sweet. the maple was such an interesting complement to the jam as well!

Delightful donuts! The pricing is reasonable and the donuts are so creative (I honestly like these better than normal donuts!) I'll look forward to visiting again :)

On our last visit we were seated in a small dining area off of the bar.  The room had about 10 small tables and when the place was full it got horribly noisy.  So loud that when the waitress came to take our order we could not hear each other!!.  I could not carry on a conversation with my dinner companion.   What was so annoying was the NO ONE from the tavern staff did anything to lessen the noise level.  The food was OK but not worth the price and if you are on a date or have a special night out THIS IS NOT THE PLACE TO GO.  Unless you don't mind going deaf and paying for it.
Great sandwiches, I had the rueben and my wife had the Cuban. The large Cuban is two full sandwiches. This is a hidden gem.

I pop into this establishment a few times a week and spend my hard earned money. This rating is simply about my experience tonight. I arrived and asked the host if I could sit at the bar area. I was told yes so I walked to a table. I sat there a good 10 minutes with zero acknowledgement. I had 3 servers all pass by, not one even looked at me. I got up and left. I won't be back!
Great wait staff.   Great food, both the presentation and food itself were amazing.  Decor and atmosphere reflects owners and management that care about not just food, but the experience.

You will definitely love Joe's Pizza. Excellent service, nice atmosphere. All so delicious and just unbelievable flavors. Workers are extremely nice and service is really swift. Would love to go back soon!
Their pizza is delicious, and the staff is nice. When I arrived, they said they hadn't received my online order, so I had to wait 15 more minutes, but they were apologetic.
Great atmosphere with wonderful hospitality. Very clean and friendly service. GM Will is the best!
Food is ok. I letter are overcooked. Prices are high and service is okay. Hopefully they improve.

Gave this place two tries, Covid or not. Every other establishment figures it out - today was repulsive 

- Dirty food behind tables
- Food not cooked thoroughly beyond disgusting and not edible. 
- Pathetic Service and clueless staff that does not care
- Manager could not care less when I complained 
- Dirty overall 
- Mold in bathroom 

STAY away from this rat hole, don't give them a dime and spare your health. 

I also called the health department.

AMAZING!! So cute and great vibes. Staff is super nice and seems like a great environment. The sweet tea pork loin was sooooo good the best mashed potatoes I've had in my life. Friend got salmon BLT she loved it! Only bad thing was there was dirty stuff in drinks. Idk if it was bugs or dirt.
I came here with a few friends for happy hour. After a lot of hype it was only okay. The food was decent, but nothing got rave about.
Totally worth the line any day of the week. Their GF crackers and vegan truffle cream cheese are must grabs for any picnics

We went out for Devour Indy last night for a night out and a delicious steak. And Sullivan's did not disappoint. Every bite of food was wonderful, and the service was terrific. So really this should have been a 5 star review. 
However we made a reservation for 7:15. When I arrived at about 7, I was shocked to walk into a packed lobby. People everywhere, no social distancing even possible. Confused host staff seemed to be trying to do their best but mostly they seemed overwhelmed. A couple I chatted with outside had a 7:00 reservation and they were still waiting at 7:20 for their table. This restaurant seemed to have severely overbooked taking advantage of the Devour Crowds. It was a disappointing start, but luckily once we were seated we enjoyed a lovely meal. If you go during these times be prepared you may be in close contact with others.

For a fast food restaurant, this place is beyond my expectation. Sandwich was served hot with real and flavorful meats. They have a variety of dipping sauces including chipotle ranch, sweet BBQ, hot BBQ, horseradish, and ketchup. They also have dispensable au ju sauce to dip your sandwich in. Prices are reasonable too and restaurant is clean. We'll come back.

1 year later I can still say this is my favorite place for coffee and a snack or lunch- everything I try is homemade and delicious. I also want to say thank you for providing curbside service so graciously. Pandemic or not, with a toddler it is a lifesaver!!

My wife found Mesa Burger on the fly when we took an impromptu toad trip up the coast for our second wedding anniversary. This was one of only two food stops we made for the day, and we would pick Mesa Burger all over again if we repeated the trip. The burgers were excellent, but if you can, try both the sweet potato fries and the parmesan and herb French fries. They were both excellent!

This without a doubt the best Asian restaurant in Tampa. My wife and I have been dinning at Liang's for 14 years. If we are not out of town you can find us there every Friday evening at 6 PM at table 31
Great staff all very capable and friendly. The food is outstanding. At least once a month I am there on Friday for lunch with friends. So one Friday a month is a "doubleheader"
Try Liang's and I promise you will love it!
Michael & Sharon
PS. Might be 15 years.

To start, service was Excellent. We were seated immediately and the server was polite and prompt. It was a Thursday afternoon so I tried the Double Cut Pork, which was the Special of the Day. An absolute Excellent Choice. The Pork Chop came out Sizzling on the plate like a Petite Filet Steak. Butter dripping and popping so had to hold up my napkin so the butter would not pop on to my White Shirt. After waiting a few minutes I took my first bite and I have never experienced a Pork Chop to be so tender and seasoned so tastefully. After the first bite the rest is history. My recommendation would be the Double Cut Pork over anything else.
Also , the Bar looks to be well stock and the Italian music made it a pleasant atmosphere. to the owner.

While visiting or working in the SB Funk Zone, or preparing for a fun ocean-side picnic, Metropulos Fine Foods has always been a sure bet for delicious food and drink, and always served with a smile by their friendly staff.

And now with the on-going virus crisis, Metropulos Fine Foods continues to feed us all with special pre-made meals, and with special pick up hours of Monday through Saturday, 10 am to 4 pm, all to-go, and all delicious.

Today their selections of meatloaf, pastas, and fresh salads, were much appreciated as we ventured through the deserted Funk Zone.

It's also been fun to keep in touch through Instagram. They are good at posting regularly to keep us hungry people informed and to let us know what's happening in their kitchen. 

Remember to support local businesses, especially ones like Metropulos Fine Foods who really care about our community.

I'll keep it short. The wine was mostly gross and overpriced. The popcorn was stale. And the bartender only carded (extensively) the one Black person that sat down. We were 3 light-skinned men of color who probably looked about the same age as this person and at least one of us looked younger, and none of us got carded.
We had crush cakes make mini pies for my daughters wedding, they delivered on time and the pies where yummy.  Thank you again!

Biscuits are yummy and not crumbly. Had one with bacon(good flavor and quality bacon) egg and cheese. Got a side of sausage gravy and grits. Very tasty and creamy. Nice clean place. The coffee wasn't that great tho. Very bitter. I tried both kinds they had to offer. On of them I wasn't sure if it was coffee or tea because it had notes of fruit and floral. The chocolate notes in the other one just didn't taste good. Too bitter. Should have tried the lemonade. But other than the coffee place was yummy!

Wed 7:00 pm and this place was packed as was the parking lot. That's why only got 4 stars.   We sat at the bar and moved chairs so we could sit together.   Food was worth the wait.  Char grilled oysters and Pacific Rim Shrimp   I'm not a big oyster fan but my date liked them.  I am a big fan of the Shrimp now that I've tried it for the first time.  Will go back for the Pacific Rim Shrimp.

One of my favorite local place to go to.  Their food taste is authentic and do not change nor trying to be all over the place.  People are true and nice, it's more like I goto their place because I miss their food rather than just to get pizza.  Makes my life lot simpler in that sense.  I value.  Thank you always.
Excelente! Authentic Mexican food. Service and food was very good and very good prices too.

Our base bar. Period. 

Great neighborhood and low key feel. Staffed, owned and frequented by "real" people. Every time we go the place is always an awesome little slice of the entire STL community.
Love from Chicago, great high quality restaurant with great management. Love this place.
The Mexican bubble roll is superb! Everything fresh and leaves you feeling satisfied.
Provides great chicken and great service. Yelp lost my order but the manager was willing to help me.

Piping hot bird but nothing special about the taste, nor serving size.  Accompanied by soggy greasy fries and a "salad" consisting of shredded iceberg lettuce and a sliced tomato on top.  Salad served with mayo, huh???  - Maybe it is a Peruvian thing, but not to my liking.

Dank af! They always make everything to order and their sushi is surprisingly good. Their egg rolls and fried rice are not that great, but definitely edible. I have never had any complaints about their main dishes. And they are cheap af!

This was our first and last visit. We came in with high hopes afterr reading reviews and word of mouth. Our pizza took over an hour to reach our table. No joke.. sat down at approx 5:45 and our meat lovers pizza arrived after7:15. When it finally arrived it smelt of microwaved hotdogs (our child's description) it had no sauce and the crust was semi burnt (not the tasteful kind). The pizza was then delivered with no spatula to service it (we had to physically get up and ask for one). At this point I think the waitress gave up thinking she wasn't going to get a tip. Super disappointing!

The food is so good! It's really authentic Peruvian grub. I got the steak and white rice and beans. The food was so good, and they doing a great job following the guidelines for Covid and cleanliness!

I use to love Dave & Buster's but this one is just a bit too busy to me. It's always hard to hear what someone you're with is saying because of how many people are around and all the games. I've never really had any problems with Dave & Buster's it's just not for me.

Pretty good place. Always has entertainment and the food is not bad. 
Shrimp and grits rocks. Service can be a little off and why for what it is....4 stars. 
Entertainment is usually good. 
Worth the visit.

Mozzarella sticks are so so (as I crinkle my nose), the dipping sauce helps to kick them up a notch.  The hubby would give the burger 4 stars.  He stated it is actually pretty tasty for a quick drive thru burger.  We normally receive great customer service, with smiling clerks.  Unfortunately, not sure if our clerk this night wanted to be at work.  Of course Sonic is our go to for shakes.  Can't beat the selection.

Friendly staff but food was horrible. Coffee was watered down , potatoes greasy , water tasted like it was sink water. I know this a local hit but I would travel further for better quality of food if you're particular about your coffee this isn't the place.

Had another fun afternoon here.  One of our favorite date night activities, even though I completely s*ck at golf.  Hubby (the golfer) takes it seriously and loves all the stats that they give.  I just hack away, but even with as lame as I am,  this place makes it actually fun to try hit the targets.  Definitely on the expensive side, but they recommended that I download the app and we got some decent coupons to help offset the cost.  There were dividers between the bays, everything was clean and all the servers were very conscientious.  Plus you are outside, with lots of good air circulation, so it felt very safe.  Nice beer and cocktail selection. Food is expensive but good quality. The staff are great at being there when you need them (keeping glasses full!) but not being too intrusive.
